resources.note: Codex has no definition-level information channel, so resources are sent per turn as experimental additionalContext entries of kind untrusted.

model.effort.note: Maps to model_reasoning_effort. Codex accepts any non-empty level a model advertises, beyond the named ones; each model accepts only the levels it advertises, so the host checks the level at launch.

skills.note: Maps to SKILL.md skills, selected by name with skills.config entries.

mcpServers.note: Maps to mcp_servers with stdio or streamable HTTP transport.

plan.note: Maps to update_plan, which must be enabled with tools.update_plan and reports progress as turn/plan/updated. update_plan is refused in Plan mode.

planFirst.auto.note: Plan collaboration mode forbids mutation by instructions only, and a read-only turn sandbox does not cover MCP tool calls.

planFirst.ask.note: Codex cannot enforce a complete lock before plan approval because Plan mode is prompt-only and MCP tools run outside the sandbox.

instance.new.note: Maps to a new thread started with thread/start.

delivery.steer.note: Maps to app-server turn/steer with expectedTurnId.

reviewer.person.note: Maps to approvals_reviewer = "user": approval requests go to the client.

reviewer.model.note: Maps to approvals_reviewer = "auto_review" with an interactive approval policy such as on-request: a reviewer agent answers approval requests; the sandbox and its limits are unchanged.

directories.note: Maps to workspace_roots in a permissions profile; :workspace_roots rules make them readable or writable.

read.note: Deny uses permission-profile deny paths and globs; Codex has no per-path approval for reads. Reads outside the zone are denied with ":root" = "deny", keeping :minimal readable for the programs the agent runs. Outside macOS, ** deny globs are expanded at startup, up to glob_scan_max_depth.

write.note: Ask relies on apply_patch approval outside writable paths. Glob entries are deny-only, so a write deny on a glob also denies reading. An approved escalation runs outside the sandbox when the profile denies no read, so deny holds only while escalation requests are refused, for example with a granular approval policy whose sandbox_approval is false.

shell.note: Maps to execpolicy prefix_rule decisions allow, forbidden and prompt, so patterns must be command-token prefixes.

network.note: Host-level rules and approvals need the experimental network_proxy feature, and the hosted web_search tool must be disabled for deny. An approved escalation bypasses the network proxy, so deny holds only while escalation requests are refused.

mcp.note: Maps to enabled_tools, disabled_tools and per-tool approval_mode prompt or approve.

delegate.note: Maps to features.multi_agent and features.multi_agent_v2; deny needs both off, since multi_agent_v2 overrides [agents].enabled. Sub-agents inherit the parent's permission profile and Codex has no spawn approval.

settings.description: Codex settings without a standard AgSDL property.

profile.description: Name of a Codex config profile to apply.

approvalsReviewer.description: Who reviews approval requests: the user, or Codex's automatic reviewer sub-agent.

webSearch.description: Codex web_search mode for the hosted search tool.
